name: Thai Chicken
description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Ken Noodle Supper
_similar.description: A hearty chicken and noodle supper with a creamy sauce, mixed vegetables, and a blend of herbs.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (10 oz/300 g) frozen mixed vegetables

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add onion, mushrooms, and garlic. Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper, and herbs. Cook until thickens.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and noodles. Return to a boil.
Add frozen vegetables. Stir and cook for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: chicken noodle supper, creamy sauce, comfort food
